description: This file contains unit tests for the class AbstractProtocolAdapterBase in the package org.eclipse.hono.service. It verifies startup sequences, service connections, message property handling, registration assertions, address validation, payload validation, and resource limit checks. The tests use JUnit 5, Mockito, Vert.x's testing extensions, and involve multiple mock dependencies related to Hono client factories and service connections.

external_files.Constants.class: Various constant values used in the implementation.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolAdapterBaseTest
classes.description: Test suite for the AbstractProtocolAdapterBase class, verifying startup, connection management, message property handling, assertions, address validation, payload handling, and resource limit checks.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock dependencies and configures the adapter before each test.

methods.name: testStartInternalFailsIfNoTypeNameIsDefined
methods.description: Tests that startup fails if the adapter's type name is not set.

methods.name: testStartInternalConnectsToServices
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter connects to all required services during startup.

methods.name: testCallbacksInvokedOnReconnect
methods.description: Ensures that reconnect/disconnect callbacks are invoked appropriately.

methods.name: givenAnAdapterConfiguredWithServiceClients
methods.description: Helper to configure adapter with mocked service clients and handlers.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesAddsStandardProperties
methods.description: Checks that standard message properties like adapter name, origin address, device ID, and TTL are added correctly.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesIgnoresDefaultsIfDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that default properties are not added when defaults are disabled.

methods.name: testAddPropertiesUsesMaxTtlByDefault
methods.description: Ensures TTL defaults to the maximum TTL when no explicit default is set.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionSucceedsForExistingDevice
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of registration assertions for existing devices.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionFailsWith404ForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Tests failure (404) when registration assertion is requested for a non-existent device.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationAssertionFailsWith403ForNonMatchingTenant
methods.description: Ensures access is forbidden (403) when requesting assertions on behalf of a device in another tenant.

methods.name: testEmptyNotificationWithoutPayload
methods.description: Confirms empty notification with no payload is accepted.

methods.name: testEmptyNotificationWithPayload
methods.description: Checks that empty notification with payload is rejected.

methods.name: testNonEmptyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Verifies that non-empty message with arbitrary content type is accepted.

methods.name: testNonEmptyMessageWithoutContentType
methods.description: Checks that messages without content type and with payload are accepted.

methods.name: testEmptyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Ensures that empty message payloads with content type are rejected.

methods.name: testValidateAddressUsesDeviceIdentityForAddressWithoutTenant
methods.description: Tests address validation using device identity when address lacks tenant information.

methods.name: testCheckConnectionLimitFailsIfConnectionLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies connection limit enforcement per tenant.

methods.name: testCheckConnectionLimitFailsIfMessageLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies message limit enforcement per tenant.
